scope: Exact finite algebra controls only. Conditional form and limit lemmas are analytic; W6 for coupled Wilson remains open. No new Lean theorem is claimed.

checks.name: noncommuting residual identity
checks.detail: Exact 2 by 2 selected operator equality for positive noncommuting 3 by 3 fast forms.

checks.name: signed pairing identity
checks.detail: Checks the sign and full matrix polarization, not just one diagonal entry.

checks.name: positive fast forms
checks.detail: SymPy exact principal-minor criterion; [A0,D] is nonzero.

checks.name: lower-reference residual enclosure
checks.detail: Ag >= kappa L implies rho*Ag^-1 rho <= kappa^-1 rho*L^-1 rho on this exact control.

checks.name: uniform-floor counterexample formula
checks.detail: A0=I, Ag has floor >=1/2 and zero Gaussian diagonal defect, but selected variation=c^2/(1-c^2).

checks.name: nonuniform analytic family
checks.detail: For g=1/n and M=n^2, delta=1/15, so delta/g=n/15 is unbounded. This is an abstract counterexample, not Wilson.

checks.name: recorded compact spectral-growth witness
checks.detail: Reproduces the exact numerical witness in W2-W3; the min-max quantifiers remain analytic.

checks.name: recorded vacuum-subtraction reversal
checks.detail: Positive bare perturbation can increase the vacuum-subtracted selected inverse above 1/2.

checks.name: four-link radial unitary conjugacy
checks.detail: Exact differential identity gives Hg=-2g^2 d_r^2+4g^-2(1-cos(r/2))-g^2/2 with the physical Dirichlet realization specified analytically.

checks.name: radial phase-volume coefficient
checks.detail: The integral gives 8/pi. This checks a constant only; the spectral counting proof is analytic.
